title: Developer docs
keywords: developer docs overview the local api, the command line client and the effect file format. /docs

title: API getting started
keywords: api getting started guides the token, the guards and two short requests to the loopback api. /docs/getting-started

title: API reference
keywords: api reference reference every local api route, grouped by area, with its body and answer shapes. /docs/api

title: About
keywords: about status and output reports the app version, build, windows edition, service version and how the previous run ended. /docs/api/about

title: About report
keywords: about report status and output returns the scrubbed support report the editor shows and copies, with the fields the bug report template fills. /docs/api/about-report

title: Output
keywords: output status and output reports the current power state, brightness and warmth of the lighting output. /docs/api/output

title: Quit
keywords: quit status and output stops the daemon after applying its exit lighting setting and telling the fan and update service the stop was deliberate. /docs/api/quit

title: Status
keywords: status status and output reports the daemon's version, power state, brightness, frame rate, connected devices, active scene and the links to openrgb and to the fan and update service. /docs/api/status

title: Devices
keywords: devices devices and lights lists the devices the daemon knows, with their zones and led counts. /docs/api/devices

title: Identify device
keywords: identify device devices and lights flashes one target led so the device holding it can be found in the room. an unknown zone or an led past the end of the zone answers 422. /docs/api/devices-id-identify

title: Device white balance
keywords: device white balance devices and lights sets the red, green and blue gains of one device. every gain must be a number from 0 to 1; any gain outside that range answers 422. /docs/api/devices-id-white-balance

title: Device zone
keywords: device zone devices and lights changes the led count of one zone on a device. an led count outside the zone's range or a zone that cannot be resized answers 422. /docs/api/devices-id-zones-zone

title: Lights
keywords: lights devices and lights lists every light with its id, led count and connection state. /docs/api/lights

title: Light
keywords: light devices and lights changes one light's name, arrangement or other saved settings. a name that is empty or longer than the group name limit answers 422; clear a name with null instead. /docs/api/lights-id

title: Flash lights
keywords: flash lights devices and lights flashes the named lights white and leaves every other led dark. /docs/api/lights-flash

title: White balance
keywords: white balance devices and lights lists each device's current colour gains. /docs/api/white-balance

title: Effects
keywords: effects effects lists the effects and saved patterns in the library. /docs/api/effects

title: Effect
keywords: effect effects returns one effect's details, including its properties and presets. /docs/api/effects-id

title: Activate effect
keywords: activate effect effects plays an effect on the groups of the active scene, using saved values or a named preset. /docs/api/effects-id-activate

title: Effect defaults
keywords: effect defaults effects changes the starting property values of an effect. /docs/api/effects-id-defaults

title: Effect favourite
keywords: effect favourite effects marks an effect as a favourite or clears the mark. /docs/api/effects-id-favorite

title: Effect presets
keywords: effect presets effects saves a named preset of an effect's property values. /docs/api/effects-id-presets

title: Effect preset
keywords: effect preset effects replaces or renames one saved preset. /docs/api/effects-id-presets-name

title: Effect source
keywords: effect source effects returns the html source of one effect and the file name a save would use. /docs/api/effects-id-source

title: Effect thumbnail
keywords: effect thumbnail effects returns the effect's thumbnail as bytes: three 16-bit little-endian counts (width, height, frame count) followed by raw rgb frames, rendered without touching the devices. the answer is sent as application/octet-stream. /docs/api/effects-id-thumbnail

title: Effect draft
keywords: effect draft effects reports the effect draft playing on the lights and its remaining lease. /docs/api/effects-draft

title: Import effect
keywords: import effect effects validates an effect file and installs it in the library. /docs/api/effects-import

title: Effect preview
keywords: effect preview effects renders a draft html effect with the given property values. /docs/api/effects-preview

title: Patterns
keywords: patterns stacks and patterns lists the saved patterns. /docs/api/patterns

title: Pattern
keywords: pattern stacks and patterns returns one pattern's frames and transitions. /docs/api/patterns-id

title: Stacks
keywords: stacks stacks and patterns lists the saved stacks. /docs/api/stacks

title: Stack
keywords: stack stacks and patterns returns one stack and the state of each of its layers. /docs/api/stacks-id

title: Stack preview
keywords: stack preview stacks and patterns starts or updates the stack used by the preview engine, for a group id the active scene has. /docs/api/stacks-preview

title: Fans
keywords: fans fans reports the fan headers, the temperatures and the active profile. /docs/api/fans

title: Fan header
keywords: fan header fans changes the mode and settings of one fan header. a percent below the configured floor answers 422: the floor is 20 percent, or 30 for the cpu and gpu headers, and a higher value can be configured. `fixed` needs `percent`, `source` needs its fields, and `curve` needs 2 to 8 `points` sorted by temperature. /docs/api/fans-headers-h

title: Fan header availability
keywords: fan header availability fans chooses whether the fan service shows one fan header; null leaves the choice to the board's own table. /docs/api/fans-headers-h-availability

title: Fan hot temperatures
keywords: fan hot temperatures fans sets the temperatures at which fans are driven at full duty. /docs/api/fans-hot

title: Fan profile
keywords: fan profile fans returns the name of the active fan profile. /docs/api/fans-profile

title: Fan profiles
keywords: fan profiles fans creates or replaces a named fan profile. a name in the body that differs from the path, or a value below the configured fan floor, answers 422. /docs/api/fans-profiles-name

title: Chains
keywords: chains scenes and chains lists the resizable headers and how their zones are set up. /docs/api/chains

title: Header setup
keywords: header setup scenes and chains starts a setup session for one header. /docs/api/chains-device-zone-setup

title: Setup commit
keywords: setup commit scenes and chains applies the chosen zone sizes to a header and saves them. /docs/api/chains-device-zone-setup-commit

title: Empty header
keywords: empty header scenes and chains records that nothing is plugged into the header. /docs/api/chains-device-zone-setup-empty

title: Setup light runs
keywords: setup light runs scenes and chains shows the coloured runs used to measure a header. /docs/api/chains-device-zone-setup-light

title: Scenes
keywords: scenes scenes and chains lists the scenes and marks the active one. /docs/api/scenes

title: Scene
keywords: scene scenes and chains replaces one scene and its groups. /docs/api/scenes-id

title: Group brightness
keywords: group brightness scenes and chains sets the brightness of one group of a scene. /docs/api/scenes-id-groups-group-brightness

title: Move group
keywords: move group scenes and chains moves or copies one group between two scenes in one save. /docs/api/scenes-id-groups-group-move

title: Group properties
keywords: group properties scenes and chains changes the property values of one group's effect. /docs/api/scenes-id-groups-group-props

title: Active scene
keywords: active scene scenes and chains makes a scene active, with a fade. /docs/api/scenes-active

title: Audio source
keywords: audio source audio chooses the audio source. /docs/api/audio-source

title: Audio sources
keywords: audio sources audio lists the audio endpoints available as sources and the resolved current choice. /docs/api/audio-sources

title: Audio test
keywords: audio test audio reads and renews an audio test lease with the id the put returned; an unknown or expired lease answers 410. /docs/api/audio-test

title: Preview
keywords: preview preview streams the whole rendered picture. each binary frame holds a 16-bit little-endian width, a 16-bit little-endian height, then width times height rgb triples. with stack=true it streams the stack preview; without it, the running effect. /docs/api/preview

title: Group preview
keywords: group preview preview streams the picture one group draws at the group's brightness. each binary frame holds a 16-bit little-endian width, a 16-bit little-endian height, then width times height rgb triples. /docs/api/preview-group

title: Light preview
keywords: light preview preview the opening message is json mapping each light index to its id, repeated when the lights change. each later binary frame holds a 16-bit little-endian light index, a 16-bit little-endian led count, then that many rgb triples. /docs/api/preview-lights

title: Displays
keywords: displays displays and peripherals lists the numeric displays with their settings and current values. /docs/api/displays

title: Display
keywords: display displays and peripherals changes the settings of one display. /docs/api/displays-id

title: Display value
keywords: display value displays and peripherals sets the number shown on a display whose value comes from this api. a display whose saved source is not the api answers 422. /docs/api/displays-id-value

title: Peripherals
keywords: peripherals displays and peripherals lists the peripherals the adapters see. /docs/api/peripherals

title: Peripheral
keywords: peripheral displays and peripherals reports one peripheral's schema and last-read values; ?fresh=true reads the device now. /docs/api/peripherals-id

title: Peripheral access
keywords: peripheral access displays and peripherals turns reads and configuration writes on or off for one peripheral. `writes` without `reads` answers 422, because a write patches what the device last reported. /docs/api/peripherals-id-access

title: Peripheral read
keywords: peripheral read displays and peripherals reports the progress of the read running on one peripheral. /docs/api/peripherals-id-read

title: Config export
keywords: config export settings and update exports the configuration as one json bundle. /docs/api/config-export

title: Config import
keywords: config import settings and update validates and imports a configuration bundle. the bundle replaces every saved setting, scene, light, fan, display, stack and pattern with the one it carries, so export the current configuration first. /docs/api/config-import

title: Dismiss zone panel
keywords: dismiss zone panel settings and update dismisses the first-run prompt to size the argb headers. /docs/api/first-run-dismiss-zone-panel

title: Complete onboarding
keywords: complete onboarding settings and update records that first-run onboarding has finished. /docs/api/onboarding-complete

title: Settings
keywords: settings settings and update returns the current settings. /docs/api/settings

title: Install update
keywords: install update settings and update installs a signed update package. /docs/api/update-install

title: Fail sensor
keywords: fail sensor diagnostics makes a temperature source report a failure, for a safety test. the source is `cpu`, `gpu` or `board:<name>`; any other value answers 422. /docs/api/diag-fail-sensor

title: Readback
keywords: readback diagnostics reads the colours the hardware reports back from the devices. /docs/api/diag-readback

title: CLI reference
keywords: cli reference reference every canvas-rgb command and flag, taken from the cli's own definitions. /docs/cli

title: Read daemon status
keywords: read daemon status status prints the daemon's status: version, power, brightness, frame rate and the scene playing. with `--json`, the answer is the raw status object. /docs/cli/status

title: List devices
keywords: list devices devices lists the devices openrgb found, with their zones and led counts. /docs/cli/devices-list

title: List lights
keywords: list lights lights lists every light with its id, led count and whether it is connected. /docs/cli/lights-list

title: List effects
keywords: list effects effects lists the built-in effects and the html effects in the effects folder. /docs/cli/effects-list

title: Activate an effect
keywords: activate an effect effects activates an effect. names ignore case. properties are `--color #ff0000` style pairs and form a trailing list, so a `--group` works before or after them. `--group` names a group of the active scene and can be repeated. with no `--group`, every group of the active scene plays the effect. /docs/cli/effects-activate

title: Import an effect
keywords: import an effect effects imports a signalrgb-format html effect. the file name is checked and the file is parsed before anything is written. `--replace` overwrites an effect of the same name. with `--run`, a run may replace only an effect that same run imported, and the effect's whole content is copied into the run's folder before the import is sent, so the old file is kept. without `--run` the overwrite is plain: nothing is recorded and no copy is made. a run is the name this invocation gives to the changes it makes; a later delete or preset save must name the same run to change what this one saved. /docs/cli/effects-import

title: Check an effect
keywords: check an effect effects checks an effect with the same parser the daemon uses and renders 120 frames. no daemon needed. `--png` writes frame 60. `--preview` writes the library tile as a gif and a contact sheet into the folder. `--prop` repeats to set a property for the 120 frames and the png. the library tile is always drawn at the effect's own defaults. /docs/cli/effects-check

title: Read effect source
keywords: read effect source effects prints an effect's html source, or writes it to a new file. an existing `--out` file is refused with an "already exists" error. /docs/cli/effects-source

title: Delete an effect
keywords: delete an effect effects deletes an effect this run imported. `--run` is the run that imported it. `--keep-presets` leaves its presets in the library. `--dry-run` runs the checks and saves nothing. /docs/cli/effects-delete

title: List presets
keywords: list presets effects lists an effect's presets, built-in and saved. /docs/cli/effects-preset-list

title: Save a preset
keywords: save a preset effects saves a preset. the name is at most 40 characters. `--prop` repeats; `--run` records the run the save belongs to. /docs/cli/effects-preset-save

title: Delete a preset
keywords: delete a preset effects deletes a preset this run saved. `--run` is the run that saved it. `--dry-run` runs the checks and saves nothing. /docs/cli/effects-preset-delete

title: List scenes
keywords: list scenes scenes lists the scenes, with the active one marked. /docs/cli/scenes-list

title: Set the active scene
keywords: set the active scene scenes sets a scene by name or id. names ignore case. a name that matches nothing prints the list and fails. a name that matches several scenes is refused and the matches are listed. /docs/cli/scenes-set

title: Create a scene
keywords: create a scene scenes creates a scene. `--from` reads a json file of groups. `--run` records the run. `--dry-run` runs the checks and saves nothing. /docs/cli/scenes-create

title: Edit a scene
keywords: edit a scene scenes replaces a scene's groups from the json file. `--run` is the run that made the scene. `--dry-run` runs the checks and saves nothing. /docs/cli/scenes-edit

title: Delete a scene
keywords: delete a scene scenes deletes a scene this run made. `--force` deletes it even when it changed since the run made it. `--run` is required. `--dry-run` runs the checks and saves nothing. /docs/cli/scenes-delete

title: Order scenes
keywords: order scenes scenes puts every scene in a new order. name each scene once, by id or name. `--dry-run` checks the order and prints it without saving. /docs/cli/scenes-order

title: Move a group
keywords: move a group scenes moves one group to another scene in one save. `--copy` leaves the group in the source scene. both scene flags are required. `--dry-run` runs the checks and saves nothing. /docs/cli/scenes-group-move

title: Pause the lighting
keywords: pause the lighting output pauses the lighting: black once, then the render loop stops. /docs/cli/output-pause

title: Resume the lighting
keywords: resume the lighting output resumes the lighting. /docs/cli/output-resume

title: Read fan status
keywords: read fan status fans shows the fan headers, the temperatures and the active profile. /docs/cli/fans-status

title: Switch fan profile
keywords: switch fan profile fans switches to a fan profile. /docs/cli/fans-profile

title: List peripherals
keywords: list peripherals peripherals lists the peripherals the adapters see. an adapter is the part of canvas-rgb that talks to one kind of hardware. /docs/cli/peripherals-list

title: Show a peripheral
keywords: show a peripheral peripherals shows one peripheral: what it has, what it holds and what the daemon may do with it. /docs/cli/peripherals-show

title: Set peripheral access
keywords: set peripheral access peripherals turns reads and config writes on or off for one device. at least one of `--reads` or `--writes` is required; a call with neither is refused. `--reads` off means the daemon never opens it. `--writes` needs reads on. /docs/cli/peripherals-access

title: Read colours back
keywords: read colours back diag dumps the colours as the hardware reports them. /docs/cli/diag-readback

title: Render effect frames
keywords: render effect frames diag renders frames locally, without the daemon. `--effect` takes a built-in effect id, such as `rainbow_wave`. an `html:` id answers `no effect with the id` because no daemon is there to read the effect file. `--frames` defaults to 60, `--fps` to 60, `--width` to 320 and `--height` to 200. `--prop` repeats to set a property. /docs/cli/diag-dump-frames

title: Bundle logs and config
keywords: bundle logs and config diag zips the logs and the config. `--out` names the zip, or a folder: when it names a folder, the zip gets a timestamped name inside it. with no `--out`, the zip goes into the current folder as `canvas-rgb-diag-<timestamp>.zip`. /docs/cli/diag-bundle

title: Fail a sensor
keywords: fail a sensor diag makes a temperature source look failed, as a safety test. the source is `cpu`, `gpu` or `board:<name>`. `--clear` removes a failure that was set earlier. /docs/cli/diag-fail-sensor

title: Export the config
keywords: export the config config exports the configuration as one json file. /docs/cli/config-export

title: Import the config
keywords: import the config config imports a file that `config export` wrote. it replaces every saved setting, scene, light, fan, display, stack and pattern with the one the file carries. export the current configuration first to keep a copy. /docs/cli/config-import

title: Install an update
keywords: install an update update asks the fan and update service, which runs as system, to install a signed build with no permission prompt. both flags are required. the command prints the signed version it started. /docs/cli/update

title: Writing an effect
keywords: writing an effect guides the html effect format, the runtime and how to check a file before you install it. /docs/effects
